name: writing
description: Ghostwrite pieces from the owner's own facts, or get coached to write them yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Ghostwrite from your facts, or get coached
interface.longDescription: Two skills with opposite authorship rules. ghostwrite interviews you or takes dictation, uses only facts from you, your documents, or the repository, and hands back a plain draft for your final edit. coach never writes your piece: it works on your own draft one issue at a time, shows a worked example on one of your sentences, and has you revise.
defaultPrompt: Ghostwrite a blog post from my notes
Write the README for this repository
Coach me on this memo draft
